Independently reasoned that E_(n+k)/E_n→1 for each fixed k because decrement is O(E_n²), enabling the two-limit Perron mixing argument. The package verify_critical_gl.py numerical tests were inspected, not treated as theorem proof or independently executed. correctness.rationale: At exact threshold r_c=1+T_M(q), finite GL logistic recurrence rearranges to x_(n+1)=Σ_(j=1)^M p_j x_(n+1−j)−r_c x_n², with strictly positive p_j summing to one for 0<q<1. The small open history cube (0,p1/r_c)^M is positively forward invariant. The finite primitive stochastic companion P has stationary positive left weights w_k=Σ_(j>k)p_j and total τ=Σ j p_j. The renewal potential E_n=w·X_n descends EXACTLY by r_c x_n², forces x_n→0 and E_n→0, and primitive mixing gives x_n/E_n→1/τ. Reciprocal increments 1/E_(n+1)−1/E_n→r_c/τ² establish nx_n→τ/r_c and logarithmic cumulative sum. The q=1 case is separately x_(n+1)=x_n−x_n²; M=1 also handled. Binomial telescoping yields τ=T_M(1+qM/(1−q)); Gamma-ratio then gives τ/r_c ∼ q M^(1−q)/Γ(2−q) at fixed q<1. The limit M→∞ follows after n→∞; no joint limit is claimed.
